title: GraphGapTarget
description: The structured scope of a graph limitation.
$comment:
Item qualifies the containing node, edge, evidence item or whole graph.
Property requires a property path; Relationship requires an edge kind and a
direction, and may name a role. Unused fields should be absent.

type.$comment: This is a special property analogous to JSON-LD's `@type` keyword.

id.$comment: This is a special property analogous to JSON-LD's `@id` keyword.

kind.description: Whether the limitation qualifies an item, property or relationship.

property.description: A property path, required for a Property target.

relationship.description: The edge kind, required for a Relationship target.

direction.description: The edge direction relative to the containing item, required for a Relationship target.

role.description: An optional relationship role narrowing its scope.
